overview_description.description: Olymon is a retail technology and e-commerce automation platform that helps merchants synchronize and manage operations between their physical stores and online sales channels. Functioning as middleware between point-of-sale (POS) systems and digital commerce platforms, Olymon enables retailers to automate critical operational workflows and maintain real-time business visibility.

about_short_description.short_description: Olymon is an e-commerce automation tool for the retail industry.

product.name: eCommerce Automation Tool
product.description: A platform designed to streamline inventory and order management for retailers, connecting POS systems with online sales channels.

product.name: Live Stock from POS/ERP
product.description: Automatically updates inventory in real-time, syncing with POS or ERP systems to reflect current stock levels and new product additions.

product.name: Monitoring and Alerts
product.description: Provides monitoring of data against various parameters with alerts for inventory, transactions, and account issues.

product.name: Online Orders CRM
product.description: Manages online orders, tracking statuses, issues, and substitutions with a focus on seamless operation.

product.name: Channel Pricing and Promotions
product.description: Enables control over pricing and promotions at the channel level, with AI-driven tools for campaign management.

product.name: Unified End of Day Reporting
product.description: Offers comprehensive insights into performance across all channels for informed decision-making.
